title: How One Daily Confession Keeps a Godly Man Walking Humbly
caption:
Pride doesn't announce itself. It just quietly stops apologizing.

Here's a habit that keeps it from setting in: confess something real today, out loud, to an actual person, before it has time to callus over.

Start with God. Skip the version with the excuse built in and tell Him the plain sentence. He already knows the true one. You're the one who needs to say it.

Then tell one brother, not the group chat, not a caption. Someone who knows your name and can ask you about it again next week.

When he corrects you, let it be information. You can be wrong about a decision without being worthless as a man. Take the note. Leave your identity out of it.

Then do it again tomorrow. Small, unglamorous, daily. Not a one time confession that resets the count to zero.

"He has told you, O man, what is good, and what does the LORD require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?" Micah 6:8.
